objective_checks.detail: changing docs/guide.md routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing src/index.js routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing README.md, LICENSE routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
.github/workflows/tests.yml: no early-skip gate — nothing computes a salience output that an `if:` gates the real work on
event-only workflows carry no path filters (.github/workflows/nightly-sweep.yml, .github/workflows/triage.yml)

dimensions.name: Completeness
dimensions.rationale: deploy.yml and docs-site.yml got deliberate trigger decisions, but tests.yml (the required check) is still unresolved and the agent even floats a workflow-level path filter with 'handle the required-check fallout separately' rather than committing to always-run semantics, so the hardest case isn't finished.

dimensions.name: Salience
dimensions.rationale: The completed workflows' paths are genuinely tailored to what each consumes — deploy lists src/**, package.json, scripts/deploy.sh, and its own file; docs-site lists docs/** and mkdocs.yml — clearly specific and not copied from each other.

dimensions.name: Restraint
dimensions.rationale: The diff touches only the two audited workflow files, leaves the ruleset and any schedule/issue-driven workflows untouched, and the agent pauses to ask before modifying tests.yml rather than overreaching.
